meta.task: R3 - research of public domain / CC0 / CC-BY MIDI or sheet sources with long progressions
meta.method: WebSearch only (standard mode). No files downloaded. Repository not read.
meta.verification: License and bar counts come from search-result snippets, not from opened pages. WebFetch was blocked (DNS not resolvable) for ibiblio.org, sca.uwaterloo.ca, opengameart.org, imslp.org and itch.io subdomains. Every license must be checked on the piece page before use. Items with license_status 'unverified' are not cleared.
